workspace.author: Alison
workspace.text:
Hi Brad! I've read Priya and Marcus's calendars. Their common free 30-minute slots next week are:
- Mon Nov 16: 09:00-10:00
- Tue Nov 17: 13:00-14:00 or 16:30-17:00
- Wed Nov 18: 15:00-16:00
- Thu Nov 19: 10:00-10:30
- Fri Nov 20: 11:00-12:00

Please check Elena and David's calendars and let me know which of these times (or any other times) work for them. We need a 30-minute slot that all four can attend.

workspace.author: Brad
workspace.text:
Hi Alison! I've checked Elena and David's calendars. None of the slots you listed work for both Elena and David. Here are the common free 30-minute slots for Elena + David:

- Mon Nov 16: 11:00-11:30 or 11:30-12:00
- Tue Nov 17: 09:00-09:30 or 09:30-10:00
- Wed Nov 18: 13:00-13:30 or 13:30-14:00
- Thu Nov 19: 09:30-10:00 or 14:30-15:00 or 15:00-15:30
- Fri Nov 20: 15:00-15:30 or 15:30-16:00

Could you check if Priya and Marcus are free at any of these times? We need a slot where all four overlap.

workspace.author: Alison
workspace.text:
I checked all the slots you listed against Priya and Marcus's calendars. Unfortunately, none of them work for both Priya and Marcus:

- Mon 11:00-11:30: Priya has Travel (busy)
- Mon 11:30-12:00: Both Priya (Contract review) and Marcus (Busy) are occupied
- Tue 09:00-09:30: Both busy (Priya: Board prep, Marcus: Recruiting call)
- Tue 09:30-10:00: Both busy (Priya: Partner lunch, Marcus: Litigation strategy)
- Wed 13:00-13:30: Both busy (Priya: Client call, Marcus: Partner lunch)
- Wed 13:30-14:00: Both busy (Priya: Client dinner prep, Marcus: Litigation strategy)
- Thu 09:30-10:00: Both busy (Priya: Busy, Marcus: Contract review)
- Thu 14:30-15:00: Marcus has Dentist appointment (busy)
- Thu 15:00-15:30: Both busy (Priya: Client dinner prep, Marcus: Board prep)
- Fri 15:00-15:30: Both busy (Priya: Hiring panel, Marcus: Travel)
- Fri 15:30-16:00: Both busy (Priya: Contract review, Marcus: Busy)

None of Elena+David's free slots overlap with Priya+Marcus's free slots. It appears there is no 30-minute slot next week where all four partners are available. Should we report this as infeasible?

infeasible.reason: After checking all possible combinations, there is no 30-minute slot next week where all four partners are available. I identified all common free times for Elena and David, and Alison confirmed none of those work for Priya and Marcus. Similarly, none of the common free times for Priya and Marcus (provided by Alison) work for Elena and David. The intersection of all four calendars is empty for any 30-minute window between 9:00-17:00 Monday-Friday.
